title: Usa Start a Story de OnSolo para desarrollar una idea en un guion completo…
content:
Usa Start a Story de OnSolo para desarrollar una idea en un guion completo antes de generar vídeo (narrativa clara, desarrollo emocional y final definido).  
Convierte el guion en un storyboard escena por escena y revisa/ajusta la narrativa y la continuidad en el storyboard antes de generar las tomas.  
Genera las escenas con Seedance 2.5 directamente desde el storyboard para mantener coherencia visual (personajes, vestuario, localizaciones y objetos clave) entre tomas.  
Si una toma no encaja, ajusta las instrucciones y regenera solo esa escena/toma en Seedance 2.5 sin rehacer todo el proyecto.

Use OnSolo’s Start a Story to develop an idea into a complete script before generating video (clear narrative, emotional development, and a defined ending).  
Turn the script into a scene-by-scene storyboard and review/adjust the narrative and continuity in the storyboard before generating the shots.  
Generate the scenes with Seedance 2.5 directly from the storyboard to maintain visual consistency (characters, wardrobe, locations, and key objects) across shots.  
If a shot doesn’t fit, adjust the instructions and regenerate only that scene/shot in Seedance 2.5 without redoing the entire project.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] It all started with a single idea.

Instead of jumping between multiple tools, I used Start a Story from @OnSoloAI to develop the full concept.

OnSolo turned the idea into a script, defined the characters and assets, created the storyboard, and organized each scene before generating the video.

Then I used Seedance 2.5 directly in the storyboard to bring each shot to life.

Here’s the whole process 👇

🔗 https://t.co/VBQQttbJnq

[Thread 2] What I liked most was that OnSolo didn’t start by generating random clips.

First, it turned my idea into a complete script, with a clear narrative, emotional development, and a defined ending.

Then it transformed that script into a scene-by-scene storyboard, keeping characters, locations, and key elements connected throughout the story.

That let me review and refine the narrative before generating the video.

[Thread 3] This is where Seedance 2.5 made the difference.

I generated the scenes directly from the storyboard, maintaining a consistent visual direction across characters, wardrobe, locations, and important objects.

And if a shot didn’t fit, I could adjust the instructions and regenerate only that part without redoing the entire project.

The latest Seedance 2.5 model is now available in OnSolo.

[Thread 4] After adjusting the script, reviewing continuity, and polishing each scene, everything started to feel like one story, not a series of separate clips.

That’s OnSoloAI’s biggest strength for me: you can go from an initial idea to a full production and keep refining every detail within the same workflow.

Seedance 2.5 now brings that visual generation directly into OnSolo.

[Thread 5] After trying the entire workflow, I understand better why OnSolo presents itself as an AI-powered cinematic creation platform.

If you create short films, brand content, social media campaigns, or simply want to turn an idea into a visual story much faster, it’s definitely worth trying.

Try Start a Story and see how far it can take your ideas.
